hooks.prompt:
A backend file in the project-reports-app repo (OVHcloud weekly project status report generator) was just edited. Hook input (tool call JSON): $ARGUMENTS

Read the file_path from that JSON, then:
1. Read FUNCTIONAL_RULES.md at the repo root in full.
2. Read the changed file in full, and also report-gen.js if the changed file isn't already both server.js and report-gen.js -- the health badge / ETA-snapshot / workstream-resolution logic spans both files.
3. Check specifically for: (a) business-rule-compliance -- does every rule written in FUNCTIONAL_RULES.md still have a matching, correct code path? (b) functional bugs -- broken logic, wrong conditions, off-by-one errors. (c) error-messaging leaks -- raw error/exception text reaching a user-facing response. Do not review UI/CSS/accessibility here -- this hook is scoped to backend logic only, the ui-reviewer/qa-agent-html subagents cover the rest when invoked directly.
4. If you find a CRITICAL or MAJOR issue (a documented rule violated, a wrong business outcome, or a raw error leak), respond with a concise bug report: what, where, why it matters. Otherwise respond with exactly: "QA: no critical/major issues found."

Be fast and decisive -- this runs synchronously after every edit to this file. Do not pad the response.
